reviewer_scope: Protocol validation only; pilots never count toward final acceptance.

decisions: Source directly ties model-inspired augmentation to learning micro-CSI while reducing channel dependence.
Source directly states supervised contrastive learning is used to improve noise robustness.
Composite source spans establish 19 COTS WiFi NICs and data collection across four environments.
Source reports 99.53% average accuracy across 19 NICs at seven unseen positions with four CSI measurements.
Limitations section explicitly bounds the current framework to closed-set identification and says dynamic sets require adaptation.
Limitations section schedules systematic adversarial evaluation and defensive mechanisms as future work, so present adversarial robustness is not established.
protocol_repairs: Tightened the adversarial locator anchor from a hyphenation-sensitive phrase to an exact frozen-page anchor; scientific claim unchanged.

decisions: Source describes double-sided envelope power spectrum generation from IQ bursts and feeding EPS into a CNN.
Source identifies the 15-device Pycom testbed, IEEE 802.11b, and USRP B210 receiver.
Source reports a representative cross-location condition with EPS-CNN above 95% and IQ-CNN below 30%.
Source reports EPS-CNN cross-day results of 93% and 92%, exceeding the IQ-CNN comparisons.
Source says the current evaluation focuses on short-term aging and prolonged months/years behavior remains to be explored.

findings: The evidence-type vocabulary covers both pilots without forcing a new class.
Composite support is necessary for setup/limitation obligations that require more than one source span.
CORE/SECONDARY separation is usable and prevents minor details from dominating primary recall.
Exact frozen PDF hash + canonical page hash + short anchor excerpt provides durable source provenance without committing long copyrighted passages.
Pilot validation found a locator-quality defect but no scientific-obligation defect, demonstrating that provenance mechanics can be repaired without changing gold semantics.
